recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes active build-scope terminology while preserving the intentional text/turtle _format alias for compatibility.
issue_request: FHIR-17356 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core HTTP issue requesting that the Turtle format media type change from text/turtle to application/fhir+turtle so the media type identifies FHIR content and can carry the fhirVersion parameter.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 13999, mirrored as git commit 6162473437bd1f1f065688569768a5c626c68532, which updated source/http.html and source/rdf.html. Later CapabilityStatement format terminology introduced by FHIR-20617 reintroduced stale Turtle media type text.
additional_context: The current HTTP and RDF narrative already use application/fhir+turtle and intentionally keep text/turtle only as an _format compatibility alias. FHIR-48679 later moved CapabilityStatement.format's main binding to supplemented-mimetypes and added simple-format-codes with the correct application/fhir+turtle definition, but the active fhir-format-type CodeSystem and capability-format-type starter ValueSet still had stale values.
reconciliation: Changed source/terminologies/codesystem-fhir-format-type.xml so ttl corresponds to application/fhir+turtle, and changed source/capabilitystatement/valueset-capability-format-type.xml from application/fhir+ttl to application/fhir+turtle.
source_changes: source/terminologies/codesystem-fhir-format-type.xml: updated the ttl definition from text/turtle to application/fhir+turtle.
source/capabilitystatement/valueset-capability-format-type.xml: updated the explicit Turtle MIME code from application/fhir+ttl to application/fhir+turtle.

related_jiras.note: Created the CapabilityStatement.format starter binding artifacts where stale Turtle media type values appeared.
Moved the main CapabilityStatement.format binding to supplemented-mimetypes and added simple-format-codes with application/fhir+turtle, confirming the remaining starter terminology should align.

evidence_items.learned: The compatibility alias is intentional and should not be removed as part of this reconciliation.

evidence_items.learned: Later format-binding decisions explain the drift and support aligning the remaining starter terminology with application/fhir+turtle.
